security.session: Server-issued HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie; Secure when NODE_ENV=production
security.passwords: Salted scrypt hash stored server-side; never returned to browser
security.mutationOrigin: POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE routes require an Origin matching PUBLIC_ORIGIN
security.authorization: Customer endpoints require an authenticated session and enforce order ownership; admin endpoints check the server-side admin role
security.production: Run behind HTTPS. Do not put secrets into public/config.js or commit .env.

login.response: User object plus Set-Cookie HttpOnly session

archive.note: Soft-archives product; active pending/paid orders prevent archiving.

rules: Server verifies stock inside a write transaction
Pending orders reserve stock for 30 minutes
Only the current user's orders are returned
Decrypted inventory values are never included in the catalog

create.note: Creates a pending payment and may return configured display-only bank details; this alone does not prove payment.

bankWebhook.authentication: x-nminhios-signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact raw JSON request body>
rules: Rejects invalid signature and mismatched amount/currency/order reference
Records unique event/transaction IDs and treats duplicate deliveries idempotently
Marks paid only after verified signed webhook
Runs auto fulfillment only after verified payment
bankWebhook.productionNote: Generic adapter only. Adapt the signature canonicalization, timestamp checks and field mapping to the selected provider's official specification before real use.

list.returns: Counts only; not decrypted inventory data

rules: Each non-empty line is encrypted with AES-256-GCM using DIGITAL_DELIVERY_KEY
Maximum 1000 lines and 4000 chars per item per request
Only pending orders can be cancelled
Auto inventory must be assigned before delivery can be confirmed
